blocker_categories.none: No active QEMU serial smoke blocker remains.
blocker_categories.limine_not_reached: QEMU serial evidence did not show Limine reachability.
blocker_categories.kernel_not_loaded: Limine did not load the KOZO kernel ELF.
blocker_categories.kernel_entry_not_reached: Limine reported kernel entry evidence but KOZO entry marker was absent.
blocker_categories.serial_not_initialized: KOZO entry was observed but serial initialization completion was absent.
blocker_categories.marker_not_emitted: Early serial initialization was observed but the boot smoke marker was absent.
blocker_categories.stack_marker_not_emitted: The boot smoke marker was observed but the stack initialization marker was absent.
blocker_categories.memory_marker_not_emitted: The stack initialization marker was observed but the memory initialization marker was absent.
blocker_categories.cpu_extended_state_initialization_not_co: Memory evidence was observed but CPU extended-state initialization did not complete.
blocker_categories.simd_survival_probe_not_completed: CPU extended-state initialization completed but the bounded SIMD survival probe did not complete.
blocker_categories.user_mapping_initialization_not_reached: SIMD survival evidence was observed but fixed user-mapping initialization did not begin.
blocker_categories.user_mapping_tables_not_validated: Fixed user-mapping initialization began but table construction did not validate.
blocker_categories.user_mapping_permissions_not_validated: Fixed page-table construction validated but permission policy did not.
blocker_categories.user_mapping_activation_not_completed: Fixed mapping permissions validated but governed CR3 activation did not complete.
blocker_categories.user_mapping_survival_not_proven: Governed CR3 activation completed but fixed mapping survival was not proven.
blocker_categories.privilege_transition_initialization_not_: Fixed mapping survival was observed but privilege-transition tables did not validate.
blocker_categories.runtime_progression_entry_not_reached: Privilege-transition tables validated but runtime progression entry was absent.
blocker_categories.runtime_initialization_not_proven: Runtime progression entry was observed but Odin runtime initialization evidence was absent.
blocker_categories.runtime_loop_entry_not_reached: Odin runtime initialization evidence was observed but controlled loop entry was absent.
blocker_categories.runtime_loop_iteration_incomplete: Controlled loop entry was observed but the three ordered iteration markers were incomplete.
blocker_categories.runtime_loop_exit_not_reached: All controlled loop iteration markers were observed but loop exit evidence was absent.
blocker_categories.runtime_status_transaction_not_reached: Controlled loop exit evidence was observed but the fixed Ring3 runtime-status transaction did not begin.
blocker_categories.ring3_entry_not_completed: The fixed runtime-status transaction was invoked but the Ring3 entry attempt was absent.
blocker_categories.fixed_user_request_copy_in_not_completed: Ring 3 entry was observed but the exact fixed request was not copied and validated.
blocker_categories.user_runtime_status_service_not_reached: The fixed request was copied and validated but the shared runtime-status service was not entered.
blocker_categories.user_runtime_status_service_not_complete: The shared runtime-status service was entered but the fixed response did not validate.
blocker_categories.fixed_user_response_copy_out_not_complet: The fixed runtime-status service completed but the exact response copy-out and readback did not complete.
blocker_categories.ring3_response_resume_not_reached: The response copy-out validated but the fixed Ring3 response consumer was not resumed.
blocker_categories.user_response_consumption_not_completed: The fixed Ring3 response consumer was resumed but its bounded result was not accepted.
blocker_categories.fixed_user_response_boundary_not_complet: The response-consumption result was accepted but response-stage clearing did not complete.
blocker_categories.fixed_user_request_boundary_not_complete: The fixed response boundary completed but the complete request transaction did not.
blocker_categories.ring3_probe_not_completed: The fixed user request boundary completed but the containing CPL3 probe did not complete.
blocker_categories.ring0_return_not_completed: The CPL3 probe completed but return to the active Odin call frame did not validate.
blocker_categories.first_session_not_entered: The controlled runtime loop completed but the first fixed user session did not enter Ring 3.
blocker_categories.first_session_not_completed: The first fixed user session entered Ring 3 but did not complete its full transaction and Ring 0 return.
blocker_categories.between_session_reset_failed: The first fixed user session completed but the governed reset boundary did not permit the second session to begin.
blocker_categories.second_session_not_entered: The second fixed user session was selected but did not enter Ring 3.
blocker_categories.second_session_not_completed: The second fixed user session entered Ring 3 but did not complete its full transaction and Ring 0 return.
blocker_categories.unexpected_third_session: Runtime evidence contains an unauthorized third fixed user session entry.
blocker_categories.later_runtime_continuation_not_reached: Both fixed user sessions returned but the later internal runtime capability path was not reached.
blocker_categories.capability_dispatch_not_reached: The fixed Ring0 return validated but internal capability dispatch entry was absent.
blocker_categories.runtime_status_query_not_completed: Capability dispatch entry was observed but the governed runtime status query did not complete.
blocker_categories.first_governed_capability_not_proven: The runtime status query completed but first governed capability evidence was absent.
blocker_categories.runtime_state_update_not_reached: First governed capability evidence was observed but runtime state update entry was absent.
blocker_categories.runtime_state_update_not_completed: Runtime state update entry was observed but the governed update did not complete.
blocker_categories.second_governed_capability_not_proven: Runtime state update completed but second governed capability evidence was absent.
blocker_categories.runtime_return_not_reached: Second governed capability evidence was observed but the governed return marker was absent.
blocker_categories.qemu_timeout: QEMU execution timed out before a passing smoke sequence was observed.
blocker_categories.missing_boot_image: The QEMU smoke script cannot find the boot image.
blocker_categories.missing_iso_generation_tooling: Local Limine or ISO generation tooling is unavailable.
blocker_categories.missing_qemu_serial_evidence: QEMU serial evidence has not been captured.
blocker_categories.missing_load_segments: Kernel ELF load segments are missing.
blocker_categories.invalid_kernel_entry: Kernel ELF entry point is invalid.
blocker_categories.limine_lower_half_phdr: Limine rejected lower-half kernel ELF program headers.
